en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

Gonta not mind studying...
Is just...hard to understand...

But Gonta will do his best.
Will Shuichi help Gonta?

If Shuichi explain, even hard stuff easy
for Gonta to understand.

Heh, heh, heh...
Gonta pretty tired, too.

Oh! Did you know? Gonta learned
this called "siesta"!

Yeah... Gonta used to clean forest air.
Dusty place like this no good...
Maybe dust is why bugs all gone.

Is there way to clean air?
Gonta wonder...

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
